title.narrative: IsDB/GPE Project for Support to Implementation of the National Education Development Strategy of the Republic of Tajikistan

description.narrative: The objectives of the project are to Enhance access to quality education facilities in the selected districts, Improve the efficacy of Competency-Based Education (CBE) by reducing the gap between declared and implemented curriculum, supporting reform in assessment practices and stock-taking of various activities for effective implementation of CBE; and, support education sector policy, planning and evidence-based resource allocation through strengthening of the EMIS and its piloting in the project area.
